content: 第一关（前）
Everything was white.

raw: From the sky above my head to the ground beneath my feet, everything I could see was a calming white.
content: From the sky above my head to the ground beneath my feet, everything I could see was a calming white.
Pure, silent, empty white.

raw: Only the flames flickered and swayed.
content: Only the flames flickered and swayed.

raw: Eventually, my dream quietly eroded, melting away until finally I awakened.
content: Eventually, my dream quietly eroded, melting away until finally I awakened.
'Where am I?'
No answer.
'Why am I here?'
No answer.
'Should I leave?'
No answer.

raw: There was no one but me.
content: There was no one but me.
There was nothing but me.
And so,
My confusion left only one——
'What... are you?'
